      "score": 0,

    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/chainparams only for address prefixes and BIP 352 parameters.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Touching chainparams to add BIP 352 constants does not affect the kernel API, boundary, or extraction."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Incidental references in fee estimation / validation hooks, no mempool policy changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The PR implements wallet receiving logic and introduces no changes to mempool acceptance or transaction relay policies."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches wallet RPC spend files and getdescriptorinfo tests to support sp() descriptors.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Wallet RPC changes serve wallet descriptor functionality rather than RPC framework mechanics."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Contains functional and fuzz tests specific to BIP 352 and wallet silent payments.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The added tests validate silent payment wallet behavior and libsecp256k1 algorithms rather than testing framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds extensive libsecp256k1 BIP 352 module code (+18k lines) and common BIP 352 cryptographic primitives.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Implements substantial new cryptographic primitives for BIP 352 inside the vendored libsecp256k1 subtree and common crypto utilities. Adding elliptic curve modules and test vectors directly affects the shared cryptographic primitives used across the codebase."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/validation.cpp (+9/-3) and validationinterface to dispatch transaction notifications to the wallet.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Modifications to validation files are limited to passing block-connected transaction data through the validation interface and do not alter consensus rules or chainstate validation."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements BIP 352 silent payment receiving, adding sp() descriptors, SilentPaymentDescriptorScriptPubKeyMan, and block scanning.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Introduces major user-facing privacy capabilities to the wallet through BIP 352 silent payment reception. While solving address reuse and transaction graph linkage without compromising privacy is a high user-value addition, as a brand-new feature it fits strategic milestone priority rather than critical release-blocking bug/fund-safety fixes."
    }

  }
